summary: Recognize both exact fleet adapter owners during recovery and revocation without switching policy producers.

replay.detail: Pending requests retain their exact owner and request identity.

compatibility.detail: Adapter readers recognize st/fleet and fractal/fleet owners for this fleet, including retained pairing journals. Renamed-owner authority can only be retained or reduced; new policy and permits still use the legacy owner. Both protocol families participate in residual-access detection. PTY access remains operator-only.

manual.detail: No migration or state rewrite required.

recovery.detail: Missing journal owner decodes as the original legacy owner.
